To explain how a pipelined CPU executes instructions, we must first understand the problem it solves: **Instruction Latency**.

In a non-pipelined (sequential) CPU, an instruction must complete all its stages before the next instruction begins. If an instruction takes 5 cycles to complete, the CPU sits idle for 4 cycles while waiting for the first instruction to finish before starting the second.
